references.matching_note: Ambient integral domain has the established commutative-unital convention.
Nonunit and unit factor are uses of exactly the ring-unit meaning.

references.disposition: A two-element factorization is equality under the ring's own multiplication; record as a basic operation rather than asserting a new notion.
Nonzero denotes inequality with the additive identity of the ambient ring and needs no separate named meaning here.

review_rationale: Read the irreducibility condition with its domain, nonzero condition, unit and factorization clauses; linked unit and integral domain and treated ordinary multiplication as ambient.
